name: Cash deposits just below reporting or identification threshold
description: Repeated cash deposits kept just under a reporting, identification or monitoring threshold.
fp: Customers may deposit regular round sums that coincidentally sit below thresholds.

links.name: Structuring below reporting or monitoring thresholds
links.ctx: Series of transactions sized to remain just below limits.
links.fp: Habitual amounts may coincide with limits.

links.name: Repeated cash deposits just below ID or reporting thresholds
links.ctx: The same user or phone number uses a kiosk several times in a short period at sizes below verification tiers.
links.fp: Frequent small purchases by regular users.

links.name: Repeated cash deposits just below reporting threshold
links.ctx: Multiple cash deposits or exchanges sized just under a regulatory reporting or internal review threshold over a short period.
links.fp: Customers with stable habits (e.g. fixed daily takings or standard float sizes) can legitimately generate similar amounts.
